Package org.geysermc.paletter.internal.creative

Record Class RawStack

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.geysermc.paletter.internal.creative.RawStack
Record Components:
identifier - the item identifier
damage - the item damage / aux value
count - the stack size
blockState - the block state as {name, states}, or null to use the item's default block (if any)
tag - the item NBT, if any
All Implemented Interfaces:
RawNode
public record RawStack(@NonNull String identifier, int damage, int count, @Nullable org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap blockState, @Nullable org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap tag) extends Record implements RawNode
A stack of the bundled creative data, described by identifiers only. It is converted to a BedrockItemStack when a palette is compiled.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with '=='.
